profile.headline: Staff Engineer @ PlayStation | Monetization Operations | Distributed Systems, Reliability & Observability Platforms | ex-LinkedIn / Allegiant / Bally Technologies / US Air Force
profile.summary:
I build platforms that scale and help other engineers do their best work.
 
Over 15 years I've built distributed systems, observability infrastructure, and developer productivity platforms, most recently at LinkedIn, where I've architected company-wide tools now used by hundreds of engineers and thousands of workflows across the organization.
 
I've designed systems from scratch, led org-wide migrations, and owned products end-to-end. I've written transition guides (SRE - SWE), created and delivered courses, and mentored engineers across multiple industries. I am always raising the bar, whether it is writing an RFC, reviewing a PR, or leading a design review, because craftsmanship does not stop at the code.
 
I care about craftsmanship not as an aesthetic preference, but as a multiplier. High-quality systems and high-quality engineers compound over time. That's what I build toward.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Staff engineer responsible for architecture and evolution of LinkedIn’s Unified Observability metrics platform, enabling executive visibility into site health, reliability posture, and organizational performance signals.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected and led development of an enterprise-scale workflow reliability platform adopted org-wide, growing to 500+ onboarded projects and 10,000+ monitored workflows, and becoming the architectural standard for pipeline alerting and monitoring across the organization. Pioneered educational programs that guided hundreds of SREs through an organizational transition into software engineering roles.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description: Led platform engineering and reliability initiatives across LinkedIn's offline data organization, delivering internal tools that automated critical workflow onboarding, establishing software engineering standards adopted across multiple teams.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Platform & DevOps
positions.description: Led modernization of the company's software delivery platform, establishing CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and engineering standards adopted across multiple teams, while partnering with executive leadership to define hiring practices and architect internal tooling used company-wide across development and airport operational systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintained and modernized legacy systems across the engineering organization, applying modern software engineering practices, improving code quality, and laying the groundwork for the platform standardization efforts that followed.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
(Now part of Light & Wonder)

Led modernization of an enterprise iGaming platform serving international clients, driving migration to modern frameworks, implementing infrastructure improvements, ensuring compliance with international regulatory requirements, and leading distributed engineering teams across multiple countries.

positions.title: Lead Architect
positions.description: Architected and delivered client-facing and internal applications across multiple industries, leading distributed web application development, introducing standardized deployment workflows, and working directly with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical architecture

positions.title: Lead Architect
positions.description: Led development teams delivering applications for major consumer brands, establishing engineering standards, CI workflows, and code review practices while serving as the technical liaison between business stakeholders and engineering teams.

positions.title: Software Automation Architect
positions.description: Designed and led automation frameworks enabling CI-driven validation workflows, improving QA efficiency through TDD adoption as an SET, automated testing pipelines, UIs, and REST APIs supporting cross-platform data validation.

positions.title: PHP Engineer
positions.description: Developed high-throughput web applications and services within a PCI-regulated environment, contributing to large-scale financial data processing platforms.

positions.title: Avionics Engineer
positions.description: Maintained mission-critical avionics systems supporting F-22 operations, troubleshooting complex electronics, collaborating with Lockheed Martin engineers on system improvements, managing high-value equipment inventory, and holding special clearances with COMSEC responsibilities.
